# 佛說摩訶衍寶嚴經

**ID:** T0351
**Volume:** T12
**Category:** 寶積部類
**Original Category:** 寶積部
**Byline:** 失譯
**Date:** 265–420
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0351

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle anonymous text is one of the parallel translations of the *Kāśyapa-parivarta* (alongside [Lokakṣema's T0350](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0042) and [Dānapāla's T0352](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0044)). The four-translation tradition (T0350, T0351, T0352, plus the *Mahā-ratnakūṭa* assembly 43) makes the *Kāśyapa-parivarta* one of the most extensively re-translated Mahāyāna texts in the Chinese canon.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (350 – 431) reflects the broad period during which the work was likely produced.

The Taishō text (T0351) is established on the standard apparatus.
